ayahs.1: Aye Nabi! Jis cheez ko Allah ne Aap ke liye halaal kar diya hai ise Aap kyun haraam karte hain? (Kya) Aap apni biwiyon ki raza-mandi haasil karna chaahte hain aur Allah bakhshne wala rahm karne wala hai.
ayahs.2: Tahqeeq ke Allah Taala ne tumhare liye qasmon ko khol daalna muqarrar kar diya hai aur Allah tumhara kaarsaaz hai aur wohi (poore) ilm wala, Hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.3: Aur yaad kar jab Nabi ne apni baaze auraton se ek posheeda baat kahi, pas jab is ne is baat ki khabar kar di aur Allah ne apne Nabi ko is par aagaah kar diya to Nabi ne thodi si baat to bata di aur thodi si taal gaye, phir jab Nabi ne apni is biwi ko yeh baat bataayi to woh kehne lagi is ki khabar Aap ko kis ne di. Kaha sab jaanne wale poori khabar rakhne wale Allah ne mujhe yeh batlaaya hai.
ayahs.4: (Aye Nabi ki dono biwiyo!) Agar tum dono Allah ke saamne tauba kar lo (to bahut behtar hai) yaqeenan tumhare dil jhuk pade hain aur agar tum Nabi ke khilaaf ek doosre ki madad karogi pas yaqeenan is ka kaarsaaz Allah hai aur Jibreel hain aur nek Ahl-e-Imaan aur un ke alaawa farishte bhi madad karne wale hain.
ayahs.5: Agar woh (Paighambar) tumhein talaaq de den to bahut jald unhein un ka Rabb! Tumhare badle tum se behtar biwiyaan inaayat farmaayega, jo Islam waaliyaan, imaan waaliyaan Allah ke huzoor jhukne waaliyaan tauba karne waaliyaan, ibaadat baja laane waaliyaan roze rakhne waaliyaan hongi bewa aur kunwariyan.
ayahs.6: Aye imaan walo! Tum apne aap ko aur apne ghar walon ko is aag se bachaao jis ka eendhan insaan hain aur patthar jis par sakht dil mazboot farishte muqarrar hain jinhein jo hukm Allah Taala deta hai is ki naafarmaani nahi karte balke jo hukm diya jaaye baja laate hain.
ayahs.7: Aye kaafiro! Aaj tum uzr-o-bahaana mat karo. Tumhein sirf tumhare kartoot ka badla diya ja raha hai.
ayahs.8: Aye imaan walo! Tum Allah ke saamne sachchi khaalis tauba karo. Qareeb hai ke tumhara Rabb tumhare gunaah door kar de aur tumhein aisi jannaton mein daakhil kare jin ke neeche nehrein jaari hain. Jis din Allah Taala Nabi ko aur imaan walon ko jo un ke saath hain ruswa na karega. Un ka noor un ke saamne aur un ke daayen daud raha hoga. Yeh duaayein karte honge aye hamare Rabb hamein kaamil noor ata farma aur hamein bakhsh de yaqeenan tu har cheez par qaadir hai.
ayahs.9: Aye Nabi! Kaafiron aur munaafiqon se jihaad karo aur un par sakhti karo un ka thikaana Jahannam hai aur woh bahut buri jagah hai.
ayahs.10: Allah Taala ne kaafiron ke liye Nooh ki aur Loot ki biwi ki misaal bayaan farmaayi yeh dono hamare bandon mein se do (shaayista aur) nek bandon ke ghar mein thin, phir un ki unhon ne khayaanat ki pas woh dono (nek bande) un se Allah ke (kisi azaab ko) na rok sake aur hukm de diya gaya (aye auraton) dozakh mein jaane walon ke saath tum dono bhi chali jaao.
ayahs.11: Aur Allah Taala ne imaan walon ke liye Firaun ki biwi ki misaal bayaan farmaayi jabke is ne dua ki ke aye mere Rabb! Mere liye apne paas jannat mein makaan bana aur mujhe Firaun se aur is ke amal se bacha aur mujhe zaalim logon se khalaasi de.
ayahs.12: Aur (misaal bayaan farmaayi) Maryam bint-e-Imraan ki jis ne apne naamoos ki hifaazat ki phir hum ne apni taraf se is mein jaan phoonk di aur (Maryam) is ne apne Rabb ki baaton aur is ki kitaabon ki tasdeeq ki aur ibaadat guzaaron mein se thi.
